title: Musicians unite in Rockatón event to help earthquake victims
seoTitle: Rockatón Event Unites Bands to Help Earthquake Victims
subtitle: Solidarity initiative brings together over seventy musical bands in favor of the affected communities
excerpt: On August 21, 2026, the Explosão Solar portal details the new edition of Rockatón, a musical event dedicated to collecting donations.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On August 21, 2026, musicians and alternative music advocates are preparing a double journey of solidarity. The event called Rockatón aims to gather aid for communities hit by a recent earthquake.

Schedule details and venue of the shows

The performances take place on a Saturday and a Sunday, August 22 and 23. The stage chosen to welcome the public and the bands is the Carlos Vieco Open Air Theater.

More than seventy bands gathered in the initiative

More than 70 bands have joined the cause to support the regions affected by the seismic tremor. Among the confirmed names in the lineup are Alcolirykoz, Bajo Tierra, Bengala, I.R.A, XMOSIS, Parlantes, Polvo de Indio, La Pestilencia, Herpes, La 45, La Toma, and Masacre.

How donations and transportation work

The organization establishes that the festival does not accept money, only specific material aid. The collected items are placed in four trucks, with an eight-ton capacity each, made available for direct transportation to the affected areas.

List of essential items accepted in the campaign

  • Non-perishable foods such as rice, lentils, beans, chickpeas, pasta, oil, tuna, and canned goods
  • Flour, oatmeal, powdered milk, panela, chocolate, drinking water, and pet food
  • Personal hygiene and cleaning products such as soaps, shampoos, toothpastes, toothbrushes, toilet paper, and feminine hygiene products
  • Diapers for babies and adults, as well as new mattresses, blankets, bedsheets, hammocks, and cooking pots

With information from El Colombiano.
